lines.beaver: 안녕하세요! 오늘 처음 오셨죠? 자기소개 부탁해요.
lines.beaver_en: Hello! It's your first time today, right? Please introduce yourself.
lines.beaver_roman: annyeonghaseyo! oneul cheoeum osyeotjyo? jagisogae butakaeyo.
lines.learner: 안녕하세요. 제 성은 브라운이고 이름은 톰이에요.
lines.en: Hello. My surname is Brown, and my name is Tom.
lines.roman: annyeonghaseyo. je seongeun beuraunigo ireumeun tomieyo.

lines.beaver: 반가워요, 톰 씨. 어느 나라에서 오셨어요?
lines.beaver_en: Nice to meet you, Tom. Which country are you from?
lines.beaver_roman: bangawoyo, tom ssi. eoneu naraeseo osyeosseoyo?
lines.learner: 캐나다에서 왔어요. 한국에 온 지 일 년 됐어요.
lines.en: I'm from Canada. It's been a year since I came to Korea.
lines.roman: kaenadaeseo wasseoyo. hanguge on ji il nyeon dwaesseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Excuse me, but how old are you?

lines.beaver: 정말 젊으시네요. 오늘 사람들 많이 왔죠?
lines.beaver_en: You're really young. Lots of people came today, right?
lines.beaver_roman: jeongmal jeolmeusineyo. oneul saramdeul mani watjyo?
lines.learner: 네, 남녀 수가 비슷하고 아이들도 있네요.
lines.en: Yes, there are about as many men as women, and kids too.
lines.roman: ne, namnyeo suga biseutago aideuldo inneyo.

lines.beaver_en: Some seniors came too. They're sitting over there.
lines.en: Oh, there are seniors here too.

lines.beaver: 그리고 신청서에 이름하고 나이를 써 주세요.
lines.beaver_en: Also, please write your name and age on the form.
lines.beaver_roman: geurigo sincheongseoe ireumhago naireul sseo juseyo.
lines.en: Okay, I wrote both my name and age.

lines.beaver: 톰 씨에 대해 좀 더 이야기해 주실래요?
lines.beaver_en: Could you tell us a bit more about yourself, Tom?
lines.beaver_roman: tom ssie daehae jom deo iyagihae jusillaeyo?
lines.en: I'm an office worker and I like cooking.

lines.beaver_en: That's great. What do you usually do on weekends?
lines.en: I just watch movies or dramas at home.

lines.beaver_en: How was the introduction time today?
lines.learner: 정말 즐거웠어요. 벌써 한 시간이 지났네요.
lines.en: It was really fun. An hour has already passed.
lines.roman: jeongmal jeulgeowosseoyo. beolsseo han sigani jinanneyo.

lines.beaver_en: It has. Please come to the next meeting too!
lines.learner: 네, 다음 주에 또 올게요. 감사합니다!
lines.en: Sure, I'll come again next week. Thank you!
lines.roman: ne, daeum jue tto olgeyo. gamsahamnida!
